artifacts.notes: Extent as the retrieving lane measured it: Complete debate, HC 3 December 1962 vol. 668 (printed by Hansard as 'Central Africal'), all 141 contribution items including the printed time-markers; Berkeley's whole speech present. Carries no printed column numbers. Retrieved with house=Lords in the query string, which the API ignored and returned the Commons debate for this ExtId.
artifacts.rights_basis: The retrieving research lane of run efff3a6f73c1f451 recorded that this is UK official parliamentary report material and that parliamentary material is published under the Open Parliament Licence. That is a real and affirmative licence, and it is recorded here as the lane found it. It is NOT relied on for retention, and the reason is stated rather than hidden: neither the retrieving lane nor this registration read the licence text or established which version governs this API's responses, so the affirmative recorded distribution basis that guidance/sources.md requires before `tracked` is asserted but not verified. What a reader with no network therefore cannot open here is the debate text itself; closing that needs a rights record for UK parliamentary material of the kind guidance/sources.md asks for when one question governs a whole body of material, and this stage may not write one on assertion.
